digest.component_or_area: Pass-1 chunk and agent pool execution
propositions: Pass-1 submits all chunks and agent futures concurrently to a 6-wide pool, causing ~3.7x token overhead due to redundant cache writes of the shared system prefix with cold cache.

When estimated shared-prefix tokens exceed CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS and there are at least 2 Pass-1 calls, the first chunk should run serially to warm the cache, then remaining calls fan out to the pool.
Small plans and single-call reviews must bypass the warm-up gate and execute as before.
A non-systemic warm-call failure must degrade gracefully to direct fan-out of remaining calls; systemic LLMUnavailableError during warm should abort the review.
